subject.title: chatCompletions: ignore request model when x-openclaw-agent-id header is present

question: Should a valid `x-openclaw-agent-id` header make `/v1/chat/completions` ignore arbitrary OpenAI SDK `model` values and use the selected agent's configured model instead?
rationale: Current code and docs intentionally treat request-body `model` as an OpenClaw agent target and reserve backend model selection for `x-openclaw-model`, so accepting generic SDK model strings changes a public Gateway API precedence rule.

options.title: Approve narrow header precedence
options.body: Allow arbitrary body `model` values to be ignored only after `x-openclaw-agent-id` resolves to a known agent, while preserving strict validation when no valid agent header is present.

options.title: Keep current agent-target contract
options.body: Continue requiring `model` to be `openclaw`, `openclaw/default`, or `openclaw/<agentId>` and direct integrations to use `x-openclaw-model` for backend model overrides.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow header precedence
recommendation.body: Allow arbitrary body `model` values to be ignored only after `x-openclaw-agent-id` resolves to a known agent, while preserving strict validation when no valid agent header is present.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current agent-first Gateway contract that this issue would relax or reaffirm.
